proof_body:
by
  intro n m f
  constructor
  · intro hf i
    exact (PiLp.continuous_apply 2 (fun _ : Fin m => ℝ) i).comp hf
  · intro hf
    have h : Continuous (fun x => WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => f x i)) :=
      (PiLp.continuous_toLp 2 (fun _ : Fin m => ℝ)).comp (continuous_pi hf)
    exact h
target_source: ∀ (n m : ℕ) (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)), Continuous f ↔ ∀ i : Fin m, Continuous (fun x => f x i)
